audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields say Pantheon's passive 'blocks one of your autos every few seconds'. Mortal Will does no such thing — Riot's text is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is EMPOWERED.' There is no auto-block in his kit. Separately, Aegis Assault is never mentioned anywhere in the matchup, and the coverage report flags that the page names none of his abilities.
audit.why: A player told their autos get blocked will disengage from trades they actually win. The real passive is a damage amp on his next spell — the tell is the stack, and the correct response is to be elsewhere when the empowered cast comes. And Aegis Assault is the interaction that decides extended fights: he becomes invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT for the channel, on a 22-second cooldown at rank 1, so the answer is to walk around him rather than to disengage.
audit.corrected: Auto-block removed and replaced with the empowered-spell mechanic; Comet Spear, Shield Vault, Aegis Assault, Mortal Will and Grand Starfall named; the front-only invulnerability stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Pantheon every stage except an even Level 6, while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] hand him 6, first item and the late game to Gwen, and whys[3] calls Levels 4-5 a coinflip.
audit.why: Gwen wins the lane at 52.96%. Pantheon is a levels-1-to-5 bully who is 'a husk past two items' by the page's own words.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, including on the ultimate the late text calls his only remaining threat.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s — three minutes at rank 1, so a spent R means he is not roaming for a very long time. Shield Vault is 13s, Comet Spear 11s, Aegis Assault 22s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added across the whys, spikes and cooldown breakdown.

edits.before: Pantheon's passive blocks one of your autos every few seconds and his point-click W stun sets up an empowered Q spear you can't answer with only a cone Q yet.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts, and Shield Vault (W, 13s) is a targeted stun into that spear — you have only a cone Q to answer with.

edits.before: You finally have Q poke and E for resets, but his passive block and W stun keep the trade even at best -- farm and contest, don't commit.
edits.after: You have Q poke and E resets, but Aegis Assault (E, 22s) makes him invulnerable from the FRONT — get behind him or the trade goes nowhere.

edits.before: His Q poke is fading and your ability sustain eats the chip, but you're still pre-mist -- it's a coinflip window, so don't overstay.
edits.after: Comet Spear (Q, 11s) poke fades as his mana bleeds and your sustain eats the chip, but you are pre-mist — a coinflip window, so do not overstay.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist arrives -- bait his W stun, drop mist so he's outside it and you go untargetable, then R-slow and out-sustain his burst.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist arrives — bait Shield Vault, drop mist so he is outside it and you go untargetable, then R-slow and out-sustain his burst.

edits.before: Survive levels 1-3 farming at the tip of Snip Snip! and refuse trades -- his passive auto-block plus W point-click stun win any short exchange
edits.after: Survive levels 1-3 at the tip of Snip Snip! and refuse trades — an empowered Mortal Will spear off a Shield Vault stun wins any short exchange

edits.before: Land the point-click W stun and chain an empowered Q spear while his passive blocks one of your autos
edits.after: Land the Shield Vault stun (W, 13s) and chain a Mortal Will empowered Comet Spear straight into it

edits.before: Pantheon's point-click W stun into an empowered (5-stack) Q spear is his kill window, and his passive eats one of your autos every few seconds, so don't try to win the trade-back here -- just farm at Snip range.
edits.after: Shield Vault (W, 13s) is a targeted stun into a Mortal Will empowered Comet Spear -- his kill window. Aegis Assault (E, 22s) also blanks damage from the front, so do not try to win the trade-back; farm at Snip range.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Pantheon and you have to respect it: his passive blocks one of your Thousand Cuts autos every few seconds, his W is a point-click stun, and a 5-stack empowered Q spear will chunk you before your cone Q comes online. Don't trade back -- farm with the tip of Snip Snip! at max range and eat a little poke rather than feeding his all-in. You have no Hallowed Mist and no E reset yet, so if he W-stuns you onto a Q there's nothing to bail you out -- soak XP and wait for 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Pantheon: Shield Vault (W, 13s) is a targeted stun, Mortal Will empowers the Comet Spear that follows, and Aegis Assault (E, 22s) makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT while he channels. Do not trade back -- farm with the tip of Snip Snip! at max range and eat a little poke rather than feeding the all-in. With no Hallowed Mist and no E reset yet, a W-stun into spear has nothing to bail you out of. Soak XP and wait for 6.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a holding pattern: his Q poke is still live but his mana starts to bleed, and your ability healing quietly eats the chip, so keep farming and don't panic. At 6 everything flips. When he W-stuns and steps in for the empowered Q, drop Hallowed Mist so HE is standing outside it -- you become untargetable to him and his follow-up hits nothing. Then R to slow, Skip 'n Slash in for the attack speed and on-hit range, and snip him while your healing out-sustains his burst. This is where you stop being prey.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a holding pattern: Comet Spear (11s) is still live but his mana bleeds and your ability healing quietly eats the chip. At 6 everything flips. When he Shield Vaults in for the empowered spear, drop Hallowed Mist so HE is standing outside it -- you go untargetable and the follow-up hits nothing. Then R to slow, Skip 'n Slash in, and snip him. If he sets Aegis Assault, walk around it: the invulnerability only covers his front, and it is 22 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Pantheon's Shield Vault (Stun): His all-in start. Mist or dodge it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Aegis Assault (E, 22s) is invulnerable from the FRONT only — walk behind him instead of walking away from the channel.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Mist or dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shield Vault (W): 13s — the targeted stun that starts it all. - Aegis Assault (E): 22s, and only his FRONT is invulnerable. - Comet Spear (Q): 11s. - Grand Starfall (R): 180s, so a spent ult means no roam.

notes: Mortal Will's exact stack count is not in the kit file — Riot says only 'every few spells or attacks' — so the page's old '5-stack' number was dropped rather than repeated. Whether Aegis Assault's front invulnerability blocks Needlework specifically (a projectile thrown from the front) is not answerable from the kit file and was not asserted.
